passes.static: grep checklist + ten-category code inspection, all 20 route files and 9 shared components
passes.live: Expo web export in headless Chrome at 390x844, light mode, 24 screens across login, register, admin, teacher and student flows

findings.summary: Register wizard: Android hardware/gesture back exits the whole 5-step form and loses the data, while the header back button steps back one step
findings.resolution: usePreventRemove steps back through the wizard on header back, Android back and iOS swipe (device check pending)

findings.summary: Custom floating tab bar and custom headers on every screen at EXPRESSION below 8 (chrome lags content); tab items have no press feedback
findings.resolution: Native headers and native tab bar via src/theme/navigation.ts; AppHeader and FloatingTabBar retired

findings.summary: Session and role gating done by a useEffect + router.replace in the root layout instead of layout guards; a wrong-role screen can render before the redirect
findings.resolution: Needs a navigation change (layout guards / Stack.Protected); gated, not done in this run

findings.summary: Sign out is a single unconfirmed tap (header icon on admin and teacher home, button on student profile)
findings.resolution: Sign out confirms via confirmDestructive (header button and profile row); verified on web

findings.summary: Tab label 'My Course' is two words
findings.resolution: Tab label is 'Course'

findings.summary: Detail routes have no stack anchor, so a cold-start deep link would land with a dead back button (not reachable today: the session is not persisted)
findings.resolution: Unreachable while the session is not persisted

findings.summary: Allocate-batch picker is a scrolling list of batch cards crammed inside a dialog; by the container rules it is a modal screen
findings.resolution: Allocate batch is a pageSheet modal screen with Cancel / Allocate, radio BatchRows

findings.summary: Scrollables use a fixed 32pt bottom padding instead of the bottom inset, so detail screens can end under the home indicator or Android nav bar
findings.resolution: Screen, GroupedList and ActionBar pad by the bottom inset

findings.summary: Screen title repeated in content under the header (course detail, student course, batch detail) and long header titles truncate at 22pt ('React Native Developm...')
findings.resolution: Header shows a short id (code / reg no / Module n); the full title lives once in the Lead block

findings.summary: Fixed hero bands with decorative circles take 170-215pt of every viewport on dashboards and profile and never collapse
findings.resolution: Hero bands and decorative circles removed everywhere

findings.summary: No type scale tokens: 30 fontSize literals and 51 fontWeight literals in screens and components, including fractional sizes
findings.resolution: Zero fontSize/fontWeight literals in app/ and src/components; all text through <Txt v>

findings.summary: No Dynamic Type bounds: zero maxFontSizeMultiplier on custom chrome text (tab labels, header titles, chips, buttons)
findings.resolution: chrome text (chips, counters, step label) capped at CHROME_FONT_SCALE; native header/tab text is platform-owned

findings.summary: Meta text at 10.5-11.5pt; weight 800 used for titles, stats and card titles alike, flattening hierarchy
findings.resolution: Type scale tops at 700 for display/title; meta text is 12pt caption

findings.summary: Accent lock broken: blue primary and coral secondary both act as accents, with cyan info close to the primary
findings.resolution: One accent (#1E6B52); secondary/tertiary are neutral ink

findings.summary: 17 inline hex/rgba values in screens and components
findings.resolution: Zero hex/rgba in screens and components

findings.summary: Muted text #64748B on the #F4F7FC screen background is 4.4:1, just under AA for small text
findings.resolution: Muted #5F5F69 on #F7F7F8

findings.summary: Primary saturation 83%; saturated per-student initials avatars on every row
findings.resolution: Avatars are initials on the neutral surface

findings.summary: Card-stack screens: register 6, admin student detail 6, profile 5, course detail 5 card wrappers; every list row is its own shadowed card
findings.resolution: Grouped lists with hairlines replace shadowed card stacks

findings.summary: Icon chip rows: 17 tinted rounded icon badges leading rows, cards, stat tiles and documents
findings.resolution: IconBadge removed; plain 22-24pt glyphs where an icon carries meaning

findings.summary: Oversized radii and no shape lock: cards 20, hero/modal/tab bar 28, login hero 36, inputs 14, pill buttons, computed badge radii
findings.resolution: One radius scale: sm 6 inputs, md 10 groups/buttons, lg 14 dialogs/modals, pill for chips/avatars

findings.summary: Stat header: four equal stats in the admin and teacher hero, plus 2x2 stat-tile grids on the admin dashboard and course detail
findings.resolution: One hero number on the admin dashboard; stat tiles replaced by grouped count rows

findings.summary: Pills that carry no state ('3 items', mode) and card-in-card panels inside batch cards
findings.resolution: Stateless pills and card-in-card panels removed

findings.summary: While data loads, list screens show their empty state ('No students found', 'No student record linked'); only the admin dashboard reads the loading flag, as a bare spinner
findings.resolution: useDataGate shows skeletons before any empty/not-found state on every data screen

findings.summary: No error state: a failed load is an unhandled rejection that leaves empty screens with no retry (latent while the API is a local mock)
findings.resolution: Error state with Try again when the first load fails; last good data kept on failed refresh

findings.summary: Filtered and search empty states have no action to clear the filter or search
findings.resolution: Search/filter empty states offer Clear search / Show all

findings.summary: Press feedback is an instant opacity/scale swap with no spring and no Android ripple; tab items, filter chips and hero stats have weak or no feedback
findings.resolution: Android ripple + pressed highlight on every touchable; no spring scale (motion dial 1)

findings.summary: Chevron on rows that do not navigate: content rows on admin course detail and teacher content have no onPress
findings.resolution: Chevron only when the row pushes; content rows open a preview without a chevron

findings.summary: Touch targets under 44pt (filter chips 36pt, compact text buttons, 18pt remove icon); custom card Pressables have no accessibilityRole
findings.resolution: 44pt targets (chips 36 + slop, header buttons 44, checkbox 44); Touchable defaults accessibilityRole

findings.summary: No haptics on confirmed outcomes (approve, reject, allocate, submit) although expo-haptics is installed
findings.resolution: haptic.success/failure on approve, reject, allocate, activate, register submit and failed validation

findings.summary: Zero autofill props: no textContentType/autoComplete on any email, password, name, phone or address input
findings.resolution: autoComplete + textContentType on login and every register identity/contact/password field

findings.summary: Date of birth is free text with the format hint in the label instead of the system date picker
findings.resolution: Still free text (no date-picker dependency installed); placeholder, example hint and clearer error added

findings.summary: No returnKeyType/onSubmitEditing chain; the keyboard action key does not submit sign-in
findings.resolution: Login chains email -> password -> go; register fields do not chain yet

findings.summary: ScrollView-of-map for unbounded data: every student, batch and course list renders through the Screen ScrollView
findings.resolution: Students, batches and courses lists are virtualized (GroupedList / FlatList)

findings.summary: One DataContext for everything; every mutation reloads all tables and re-renders every mounted screen
findings.resolution: Data layer unchanged; out of scope for a visual redesign

findings.summary: Greeting headers: 'Hi, Ananya', 'Hi, Ritu', 'Welcome back, {name}'
findings.resolution: No greeting headers; dashboards titled by purpose

findings.summary: Internal enum jargon in user copy ('move them to ALLOCATED', raw RUNNING/UPCOMING, 'ID PROOF') and developer notes shipped as UI text ('No storage is wired up yet')
findings.resolution: Enum jargon and developer notes replaced with plain copy

findings.summary: App identity mismatch: app.json says 'IGCA', the login screen says 'Student Management'; a few cute strings ('Inbox zero', 'You are the first one here')
findings.resolution: Login says 'Student Management', app.json says 'IGCA'; needs an owner decision

trunkTest.detailScreens: PASS, except admin course detail PARTIAL (title truncates)
trunkTest.login: PARTIAL on 'what app is this' (name mismatch with app.json)
trunkTest.deepLinkedDetail: N/A: session is not persisted, so no detail screen can be entered cold
